name: swiftui-pro
changes: Reused the existing SwiftUI Pro family, updated to the pinned reviewed commit.
Kept one standalone Skill plus its 12 reference Markdown files; removed the duplicate nested Skill and plugin manifest.
Removed unconditional deployment-target/Swift-version defaults and rigid per-type file splitting.
Scoped reference advice to the project and required evidence for version-sensitive API claims.
update_policy: Pinned local adaptation. Re-audit before updating; do not replace via a whole-plugin installer.
